title: Why Are 96,000,000 Black Balls on This Reservoir?
summary: Veritasium rides a boat across the Los Angeles reservoir covered in 96 million black plastic balls. He explains why they were really introduced, which was not primarily to reduce evaporation.
why: Referenced as the explanation of shade balls and used in discussions of evaporation and floating covers.

quote.text: I thought the engineering at play here was pretty interesting.
